newsitem.title: USA: Mylan gets FDA approval on 200 mg acyclovir.
newsitem.headline: Mylan gets FDA approval on 200 mg acyclovir.

text.p: Mylan Laboratories Inc said on Wednesday that it had received approval from the Food and Drug Administration to manufacture and market acyclovir capsules in 200 mg strength.

Acyclovir is the generic equivalent of Glaxo Wellcome's Zovirax, an antiviral drug used to treat episodes of genital herpes in some patients, as well as herpes Zoster, known as shingles, and chicken pox.
The company also said shipment of the new dosages would begin immediately.
Mylan is a pharmacuetical company that specializes in marketing and manufacturing generic drugs.
